adoptedDecisions: Closed create/revise/parameter prepareDataUpdate request and synchronous applyDataUpdate action; Basic supports create only
Typed data-source owns current intent/output; immutable dataset receipt owns historical received content and parser provenance
Exact original receiver plus host current request token, input hashes and revisions reject stale completion and ABA
Manual rows revision detaches its live source; field/generated row identity rules remain explicit
Private prepared context preserves editParameter's approved target/value shape and one atomic dependency closure
